info.title: Access management API
info.description: Realm-admin (`/admin/v1/realms/{slug}`) and platform-admin (`/admin/v1/platform`) surfaces on the management listener. Reads take a holder-bound DPoP token of the surface's audience living at most 60 minutes; writes take the caller's AIS and compile to an Exercise; there is no bearer management token (TN-110, TN-119, TN-130). Field names are snake_case, times RFC 3339 UTC, 64-bit integers strings (OP-65).

get.summary: The platform-admin surface: its audience, scope namespace and rate policies.
One realm's admin surface: its audience, scope namespace and rate policies.

post.summary: Drafts the intent a write compiles to, for the caller's AIS; changes nothing.

get.summary: The realm's clients.

post.summary: Registers a client; a client_secret_basic client's secret is shown once.

get.summary: One client.

put.summary: Replaces a client's registration.

patch.summary: Changes a client's registration by JSON Merge Patch.

post.summary: Retires a client; its client_id is never reused.
Issues a new client_secret, shown once; the old one stays valid for 24 hours.

get.summary: The realm's groups.
One group.

put.summary: Creates a group with its one membership issuer, or renames it.

patch.summary: Renames a group by JSON Merge Patch.

post.summary: Retires a group and ends its memberships.
Adds accounts to a group the administration issues members of.
Removes accounts from a group the administration issues members of.

get.summary: The realm's accounts and their states.
One account's state.

post.summary: Imports accounts from another identity provider (idp.account.import, TN-85): `content` is the JSON Lines file of `access-server import-accounts`, `file` its SHA-256 and `accounts` its line count, which the signed change names; each line becomes its own account or is reported as skipped, never echoed.

Records that `guardian_account_id` stands for this ward on `basis` (`parent`, `legal_guardian`) in `country` (idp.account.guardianship_record, CT2, E53): its guardianship Claim holds until the ward's majority by the country table and ends then without anyone's signature; the ward's date of birth must be on file.

Binds the account and `peer_account_id` of the tenant's realm `peer_realm` (its slug) as one person (idp.account.bind, CT2): the realm that binds first answers with its realm-signed `offer`, shown once; the peer realm's administrator binds the same pair sending that `offer`, which the peer realm verifies against this realm's keys.

Exports every active account to another deployment (idp.account.migration_export, reserved, TN-86): sealed to the P-256 `recipient` key (SEC1, base64url) it names; the `bundle` (dCBOR, base64url) is shown once and holds the import lines that deployment's importAccounts takes.
Suspends an account and ends its sessions.
Reactivates a suspended account.

get.summary: The realm's upstream identity providers.
One upstream identity provider.

put.summary: Registers or replaces an upstream identity provider (reserved).

patch.summary: Changes an upstream identity provider by JSON Merge Patch (reserved).

post.summary: Retires an upstream identity provider.

get.summary: The social presets the realm enabled, with their warnings (IDP-31, TN-87).
One social preset the realm enabled.

put.summary: Enables or changes a social preset; only a sandbox realm may omit its own client (idp.social.enable, update).

patch.summary: Changes a social preset's client by JSON Merge Patch (idp.social.update).

post.summary: Stops offering a social preset; linked sign-ins stay (idp.social.disable).

get.summary: The realm's live organizations (§8.5 S7).

post.summary: Creates an organization bound to the Party its founder's client registered; the founder becomes its first owner (TN-5).

get.summary: One organization: its roots and members with each membership source and role, its domain claims, ownership handovers and connection drafts (§8.5 S7, TN-91).

patch.summary: Renames an organization or turns home realm discovery to it on or off; on needs a verified domain no other organization claims (TN-98).

post.summary: Removes a member from an organization; its last active owner is kept (TN-91).
Invites a person into an organization by e-mail: the link and its magic code go only in the mail, the role comes from the invitation (TN-89).
Revokes an open invitation (OP-153 m.3 (o)).

Claims a domain for an organization; its challenge, shown once, is published as a DNS TXT record or an HTTPS document, and the domain counts as verified only while its time-limited domain_verification Claim holds (TN-90).
Releases an organization's domain claim and retracts its verification (TN-90).
Drafts an enterprise connection; only idp.upstream.register (CT3) at the organization's root puts it into effect (TN-120).
Links a subject of the upstream identity provider to an account; its inbound signals then reach the account.

get.summary: The realm's settings: sign-in, session, branding, RP ID, mappers.

put.summary: Sets the sign-in requirements.

patch.summary: Changes the sign-in requirements by JSON Merge Patch.

put.summary: Sets the console session policy.

patch.summary: Changes the console session policy by JSON Merge Patch.

put.summary: Sets the hosted pages' branding.

patch.summary: Changes the hosted pages' branding by JSON Merge Patch.

put.summary: Sets the hosted pages' CSP mode: `enforce`, or `report_only`, which loosens the page and is a higher tier (OP-153 m.22 (g)).
Sets the realm's Related Origins: https origins under the organizations' verified domains, at most five registrable labels with the RP ID's (TN-18).
Sets the realm's texts for the hosted pages by locale and message key: plain text, known keys only, never a protected one (X35).
Pins or changes the WebAuthn RP ID: irreversible, reserved.
Sets or removes the profile attribute a claim is taken from.
Sets the realm's JOSE signing algorithm: ES256 or Ed25519.
Sets which Client ID Metadata Document clients the realm accepts.

patch.summary: Changes the CIMD acceptance policy by JSON Merge Patch.

put.summary: Sets the attack protections' modes; loosening anything is a higher tier.

patch.summary: Changes the attack protections' modes by JSON Merge Patch.

post.summary: Makes an account a canary: a sign-in with it never opens a session.
Deletes an account after its cancellation window; its personal data becomes unreadable when its keys are destroyed later (reserved).
Issues a one-time reset intent sent to the account's own registered address; the person chooses their new sign-in method themselves (TN-61).
Issues a temporary access pass, shown once to read out, in a realm that allows them; its session binds an authenticator only (TN-62).

put.summary: Sets the recovery policy; anything that loosens it is a higher tier and only applies to recoveries started later (TN-55).

post.summary: Starts a bulk job: each item is its own write under its own AIS, and `revokeGrant` or `amendGrant` items are Grant revokes or amends, each its own Exercise (E17); `issueRoleGrant` issues an accepted invitation's role (TN-89), `proposeOwnershipHandover` (accepted, nothing decided yet) and `completeOwnershipHandover` carry an organization's `anchor_transfer` (TN-91), and `issueAutojoinGrant` (key: the organization) an owner's `grant_issue` of the autojoin role, held by the organization's `org_member` Claims (TN-90); answers 202.

get.summary: A bulk job's state and counts, throttled items included.
A bulk job's per-item results: the Exercise or the problem that refused it.

post.summary: Moves the realm to another governing domain: declared and reserved, never applied.

put.summary: Sets whether hooks and webhooks may reach declared private targets and what hooks may receive.

patch.summary: Changes the extension policy by JSON Merge Patch.

get.summary: The realm's inline hooks.

post.summary: Registers an inline hook at one call point; its verification key is shown once.

get.summary: One inline hook.

post.summary: Retires an inline hook; a URL change is a retirement and a new registration.

get.summary: The realm's webhooks.

post.summary: Registers a webhook; its verification key is shown once.

get.summary: One webhook.

put.summary: Replaces a webhook's URL and events.

patch.summary: Changes a webhook's URL or events by JSON Merge Patch.

post.summary: Issues a new signing key, its verification key shown once; the old key signs too for 24 hours.
Retires a webhook; its pending deliveries fail.

get.summary: A webhook's delivery log, newest first: state, attempts and the last answer; never the event body.
The realm's signal sources: delayed transmitters, the GeoIP source, verifier reports.
The realm's daily sign-in counts of the last 30 days and failed sign-in surges; never a decision input.
The realm's full-taxonomy audit stream, oldest first, as OCSF, CEF or SET claims; a copy, not the record. Each read is itself audited.
The event's inclusion proof in the realm's own audit tree, checkpointed by the cell key under the realm's origin; it shows nothing of other realms. Each read is itself audited.
The realm's custom domains: host, verification state, next re-check, certificate expiry (OP-156 m.3 (i)).

post.summary: Registers a custom domain to verify by DNS TXT `_access-challenge.<host>` and a CNAME to `<slug>.<base>`: idp.domain.register.

get.summary: One custom domain: the TXT value and CNAME target to publish, the verification state and the ACME certificate.

post.summary: Retires a custom domain; it is no longer served and nothing is deleted (OP-73): idp.domain.retire.
Binds the issuer or passkey RP ID to a verified custom domain, irreversibly (§10.2.4, TN-16): idp.domain.issuer_bind (reserved).

get.summary: The realm's export sinks for the read-only SIEM projection and their cursors; a copy, not the record (OP-156 m.3 (s)).

post.summary: Registers an export sink (OCSF Parquet on S3, OTLP logs, HTTP collector, syslog CEF or LEEF): idp.export.sink_register.

put.summary: Replaces an export sink's configuration: idp.export.sink_update.

post.summary: Retires an export sink: idp.export.sink_retire.

get.summary: The realm's agents: kind, operator, sponsors and status (OP-154 m.3 (c), (e)).

post.summary: Registers an agent bound to one self-registered agent Party: idp.agent.register (OP-154 m.3 (c)).

get.summary: One agent: kind, operator, sponsors, status, authority, connected accounts and last run.

patch.summary: Changes an agent's name and description by JSON Merge Patch: idp.agent.update.

post.summary: Retires an agent: idp.agent.retire; nothing is deleted (OP-73).
Ends every Instance of the agent as a bulk job of the caller's signed instance_terminate items (OP-154 m.3 (f), P59).

get.summary: The agent's human sponsors (AG-41).

post.summary: Assigns a human sponsor: idp.agent.sponsor_assign (OP-154 m.3 (e)).
Removes a sponsor: idp.agent.sponsor_remove; the last one leaving suspends the agent (OP-154 m.3 (e)).
Defines an agent Grant template; one without a budget is refused (OP-154 m.3 (g)).

get.summary: The realm's protected resources and MCP servers, by canonical URI.

post.summary: Registers a protected resource or MCP server for `resource` validation: idp.client.resource_register.

put.summary: Sets the dynamic client registration profile: idp.client.dcr_policy, or dcr_policy_tighten when it only narrows (OP-154 m.3 (j)).

post.summary: Records a cross-app connection for ID-JAG: idp.client.cross_app_connection (OP-154 m.3 (n)).
Retires a cross-app connection: idp.client.cross_app_connection_retire.

put.summary: Turns the device authorization grant on (idp.realm.device_code) or off (device_code_close) (OP-154 m.3 (p)).

get.summary: The realm's vault Resources: the catalog upstreams it enabled and its own (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

put.summary: Enables a catalog upstream (idp.vault.resource_enable) or registers the realm's own (resource_register, reserved).

post.summary: Disables a vault Resource: idp.vault.resource_disable.

put.summary: Opens release path (b) for CT0-CT1 classes (idp.vault.release_mode_open) or closes it (release_mode_close) (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

get.summary: The realm's SAML service providers and WS-Federation relying parties: entity ID, template, status (OP-155 m.3 (e)).

post.summary: Registers a SAML service provider from its metadata or SSO catalog template: idp.saml.sp_register, or sp_mapping (reserved) when the template maps a Claim that selects authority.

get.summary: One SAML service provider: entity ID, ACS and SLO endpoints, NameID format, attribute release, signing algorithm and its interop profile.

put.summary: Replaces a SAML service provider's registration: idp.saml.sp_update.

post.summary: Retires a SAML service provider: idp.saml.sp_retire; its entity ID is never reused and nothing is deleted (OP-73).

put.summary: Sets the SAML signing certificate rotation policy: idp.saml.cert_policy (OP-155 m.3 (e)).

post.summary: Replaces the SAML signing certificate at once, outside the policy: idp.saml.cert_emergency (reserved).

get.summary: The realm's inbound SCIM clients: name, tolerance profile, status, last request (OP-155 m.3 (g)).

post.summary: Registers an inbound SCIM client: idp.scim.client_register; its opaque bearer secret is shown once and only its SHA-256 is kept.
Replaces an inbound SCIM client's bearer secret, shown once; the old one stops working at once (OP-155 m.3 (g)).
Retires an inbound SCIM client: idp.scim.client_retire.

get.summary: The realm's outbound SCIM targets and their last results; never a secret.

post.summary: Registers an outbound SCIM target whose secret is sealed in the vault: idp.scim.outbound_register.
Retires an outbound SCIM target: idp.scim.outbound_retire.

get.summary: The realm's edge gateways (SAML, LDAP, RADIUS, Kerberos) with their internal identity and status (OP-155 m.3 (c)).

post.summary: Registers an edge gateway and its mTLS identity urn:suiss:access:gw:<kind>:<name>: idp.gateway.register.
Retires an edge gateway; its identity is never reused: idp.gateway.retire.

put.summary: Sets a Kerberos gateway's keytab rotation policy: idp.gateway.keytab_policy (OP-155 m.3 (o)).

post.summary: Replaces a Kerberos gateway's keytab at once: idp.gateway.keytab_emergency (reserved).
Registers a RadSec client of a RADIUS gateway; RADIUS over UDP is never answered: idp.gateway.radius_client_register (OP-155 m.3 (f)).

put.summary: Turns OpenID Federation on as a leaf (idp.federation.enable) or off (disable) (OP-155 m.3 (j)).

get.summary: The trust anchors the realm trusts and each chain's state.

post.summary: Trusts a federation's trust anchor: idp.federation.trust_anchor_add (reserved).
Stops trusting a trust anchor: idp.federation.trust_anchor_remove.

put.summary: Turns on the intermediate or trust anchor role, off by default: idp.federation.ta_enable.
Opens (idp.federation.registration_open) or closes (registration_close) OIDF client registration.
Turns the OID4VP verifier on (idp.vc.verifier_enable) or off (verifier_disable) (OP-155 m.3 (p)).
Sets the trusted lists whose issuers the verifier accepts: idp.vc.trusted_list (reserved).
Turns the person-attribute OID4VCI issuer on (idp.vc.issuer_enable) or off (issuer_disable).
Puts a client under FAPI 2.0 (idp.client.profile) or takes it out (profile_loosen) (OP-155 m.3 (k)).
Allows a client client_secret_post or client_secret_jwt: idp.client.auth_method_legacy.
Lets a client take RS256 identity assertions: idp.client.alg_rs256; the realm's RSA-3072 key is made on first use (MD-6).
Turns on JWE for a client's identity assertions, userinfo or JARM: idp.client.encryption; RSA1_5 is never offered.
Allows a client the SAML 2.0 bearer grant from an accepted SAML upstream: idp.client.saml_bearer.
Grants a client the legacy bearer exception, never advertised: idp.client.legacy_bearer.
Turns CIBA poll and ping on (idp.realm.ciba) or off (ciba_close) (OP-155 m.3 (l)).
Turns on certificate, PIV and CAC sign-in: idp.realm.certificate_login (OP-155 m.3 (m)).
Publishes mtls_endpoint_aliases on the mTLS listener: idp.realm.mtls_aliases.
Turns home realm discovery on (idp.realm.hrd) or off (hrd_close) (OP-155 m.3 (h)).
Lets the realm's clients opt in to front-channel logout: idp.realm.frontchannel_logout.

get.summary: What enforcing SSO on the organization would end: members' local sign-in methods, API keys, sign-ins and refresh families, service accounts included, and the pending invitations (OP-155 m.3 (i)); changes nothing.

post.summary: Enforces SSO on the organization: idp.org.sso_enforce; the body names the pending invitations' fate (cancel or redirect_to_sso), there is no default.
Lifts the organization's SSO enforcement: idp.org.sso_enforce_lift.
Issues the organization's one-use SSO setup link, valid 72 hours and sent by Relay: idp.org.setup_link.

put.summary: Maps an upstream's acr, amr or AuthnContextClassRef onto assurance; unmapped values count as the lowest class: idp.upstream.assurance_map (reserved).

get.summary: The realm's forward-auth proxies and Access Proxy instances, each a PEP (OP-156 m.3 (l), (m)).

post.summary: Registers a proxy as a PEP with its application, engine and upstream: idp.proxy.register.

get.summary: One proxy: application, engine, decision cache bound, header mode, MCP pins.

put.summary: Replaces a proxy's registration: idp.proxy.update.

post.summary: Retires a proxy: idp.proxy.retire.

put.summary: Turns the plain identity headers on (idp.proxy.plain_headers) after the setup check proves the application unreachable except through the proxy, or off (plain_headers_close).

post.summary: Pins an MCP server's tool list by the SHA-256 of each tool's canonical definition; a changed or new tool is blocked until pinned again: idp.proxy.mcp_pin (OP-156 m.3 (n)).

put.summary: Turns the realm's Ed25519 SSH user CA on (idp.ssh.ca_enable) or off (ca_disable) (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

post.summary: Rotates the SSH CA key on its schedule: idp.ssh.ca_rotate.
Replaces the SSH CA key at once: idp.ssh.ca_emergency (reserved).

get.summary: The realm's SSH server groups, the resources of ssh.login Grants.

post.summary: Registers an SSH server group: idp.ssh.host_group_register.
Retires an SSH server group: idp.ssh.host_group_retire.

get.summary: The realm's Linux client hosts with their server group, offline limits and break-glass switch (OP-156 m.3 (p)).

post.summary: Registers a Linux host of the Linux client: idp.linux.host_register.
Retires a Linux host: idp.linux.host_retire.

put.summary: Sets a host's offline cache limits within its ValidityContract horizon: NSS data at most 12 hours, console sign-in at most 8, no step-up offline: idp.linux.offline_policy.
Sets a host's local break-glass policy over a one-use offline PAP slice: idp.linux.break_glass_policy (reserved).

get.summary: The realm's HR sources, each a Claim issuer whose selection effect is a CT3 subject-selection Acceptance (OP-156 m.3 (q)).

post.summary: Registers an HR source: idp.hr.source_register.
Retires an HR source: idp.hr.source_retire.
Imports at most 10 000 JSONL HR records into the source's Claims: idp.hr.import.
Imports an RFC 4180 CSV file of at most 10 MB with the fixed columns and a header row: idp.hr.import.

get.summary: The realm's HR connectors of services/hr-connector and their last pull.

post.summary: Registers an HR connector: idp.hr.connector_register.
Retires an HR connector: idp.hr.connector_retire.

get.summary: The realm's signal sources (KYC, MDM, risk, DLP), each a Claim issuer whose effect needs an Acceptance (OP-156 m.3 (r)).

post.summary: Registers a signal source: idp.signal.source_register.
Retires a signal source: idp.signal.source_retire.

put.summary: Turns push verification with number matching on (idp.realm.push) or off (push_close) (OP-156 m.3 (d)).
Turns the restricted SMS one-time code on (idp.realm.sms_otp) or off (sms_otp_close) (OP-156 m.3 (f)).
Opens Permissions-Policy: payment on the approval surface for Secure Payment Confirmation: idp.realm.spc (OP-156 m.3 (g)).
Names the coordinator URL the hub links pending approvals to: idp.realm.coordinator (OP-156 m.3 (t)).
Turns the İYS consent registry events on (idp.realm.iys) or off (iys_close).
Sets the realm's own preference topics beside campaign, newsletter and product_news: idp.realm.preference_topics (OP-153 m.3 (ee)).
Turns the immediate security authority notices on (idp.realm.security_notices) or off (security_notices_close); on by default (OP-156 m.3 (c)).

get.summary: The realm's Relay messages the courier gave up on, without their sealed content (OP-156 m.3 (c)).

post.summary: Resends an undelivered Relay message as a new outbox row citing the original: idp.relay.resend. A crypto-shredded message answers content-shredded, an expired one message-expired.
Drafts the intent a provisioning write compiles to, for the caller's AIS; changes nothing.

get.summary: Tenants and their states; metadata only.

post.summary: Creates a tenant.

get.summary: One tenant's metadata.
A tenant's realms; metadata only.

post.summary: Creates a realm by a Genesis of its governing domain with the caller's founding root; Joint(k >= 2) is recommended, a sole root must acknowledge that it cannot be recovered.

get.summary: A tenant's sandbox domains.

post.summary: Creates a sandbox realm whose governing domain is a separate AuthorityDomain from the sandbox template, with its fixed budget.

get.summary: One realm's metadata and the state of its signing keys; never its settings or content.
The deployment's readiness checks, by name; no secrets.

Problem.description: RFC 9457. `type` is `urn:suiss:access:problem:<code>`, or `about:blank` when the status says all; the codes are listed in `problems.json`.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the request body, as a URI fragment.

code.description: Stable code of what is wrong there.

Position.description: A ledger position, in decimal: 64-bit integers are strings (OP-65).

ExerciseRef.description: The Exercise a write compiled to and its position (TN-110).

Validity.description: The intent's validity, at most 15 minutes; the draft fills it in (TN-110).

WriteBody.description: The operation's resource members as the draft returned them, with `validity` and, unless sent as `X-Access-AIS`, the `ais`. No member writes a credential (TN-61).

ais.description: The caller's AIS, unpadded base64url of its COSE_Sign1, when not in the header.

key.description: The path's natural key, for operations on one resource.

IntentDraft.description: What the caller signs: an AIS over `intent_digest` for `domain` and `pep`, mode `commit`, then the write with `body` (TN-110, PI-7). Drafting changes nothing.

intent.description: Deterministic CBOR of the intent, unpadded base64url.

Client.description: A client registration (TN-15, IDP-7). No secret is ever read back (CR-38).

spiffe_id.description: A workload client's SPIFFE ID, or a whole-segment prefix ending in /*; any other wildcard selects nothing (OP-154 m.3 (r)).

spiffe_bundle_endpoint.description: The https Bundle Endpoint of the workload client's trust domain (OP-154 m.3 (r)).

agent.description: The agent Party whose Instances the workloads become, unpadded base64url (OP-154 m.3 (d)).

Group.description: A group with its one membership issuer (TN-117); membership is an identity Claim, never authority.

Account.description: An account's state (§12.3.1). There is no credential field: a reset goes through the account's own flows (TN-61).

Agent.description: An agent of the realm (OP-154 m.3 (c), (e)): its own agent Party, the operator it runs for, its human sponsors and what it is connected to. It is exported to the authority plane only as `agent_kind`, `operated_by` and `sponsored_by` Claims; it holds no authority of its own (AG-19).

agent.description: Opaque id of the agent Party.

display_name.description: Name shown to people; attacker input, rendered as text.

operator.description: The operator Party: an organization or a person.

sponsors.description: The human sponsors' account ids; at least one while the agent is active.

connections.description: Connected accounts for agents, by connection id; never a token.

UpstreamIdp.description: An upstream identity provider's registration (OP-150 m.11 (j)); its client secret only by `secret://` reference.

client_id.description: Access's client id at the provider.

ssf.description: The provider as an SSF push transmitter: `issuer`, `jwks_uri`, `aud`, `events`, `expected_interval_s` (OP-151 m.7 (g)).

Organization.description: An organization as S7 reads it (§8.5 S7, §12.3.8): its id is its Party's base64url; its roots and members, each with how the membership began (apart from any sign-in source) and its role's versioned Grant; its domain claims with their watch state; its ownership handovers, which are root standing and never billing (TN-91); its connection drafts, which nothing puts into effect but idp.upstream.register (TN-120). The list form carries only `organization`, `display_name` and `hrd`.

SocialProvider.description: A social preset the realm enabled (IDP-31, OP-153 m.3 (l)): its client secret only by `secret://` reference; no client means the operator's shared development client, which only a sandbox realm may use. Warnings never refuse anything (TN-87, IDP-31 (5)).

Hook.description: An inline hook (TN-135): one live hook per call point; a URL change is a retirement and a new registration. Its signing key is never read back (TN-61).

hook_id.description: Server-generated `hok_` id (OP-137); the draft assigns it.

url.description: https on a DNS name, port 443, unless the extension policy allows a target the operator declared (OP-151 m.10 (e)).

disclose.description: Personal data it may receive; only at `pre_registration` and only what the extension policy permits.

Webhook.description: A webhook (TN-136): signed CloudEvents of identity events, at least once. Its keys are never read back (TN-61).

webhook_id.description: Server-generated `whk_` id (OP-137); the draft assigns it.

url.description: https on a DNS name, port 443, unless the extension policy allows a target the operator declared (OP-151 m.10 (e)).

items.description: An identity event name of the catalogue (OP-151 m.3 (i)).

Signals.description: The realm's signal sources (§8.13): a delayed source is stated, never hidden, and decisions keep using declared validity windows.

delayed_since.description: Since when it is delayed, Unix ms; null while on time (OP-151 m.7 (g)).

geoip.description: The GeoIP source; without one geographic signals are unavailable (OP-151 m.3 (o)).

verifiers.description: Verifier reports past their declared window; none is stored yet.

Analytics.description: Daily sign-in counts of the last 30 days and failed sign-in surges (IDP-36): counters only, never a decision input.

WebhookDelivery.description: One delivery of a webhook's log (TN-136); the event body is never read back. An item of `listWebhookDeliveries`.

event_id.description: The event id: the dedup key and `webhook-id`.

event.description: The event name of the catalogue (OP-151 m.3 (i)).

Settings.description: The realm's settings: JOSE algorithm, Argon2, RP ID, CIMD, sign-in requirements (TN-132), console session policy (TN-129), branding (TN-106), mappers (TN-117), the extension policy (`allow_private_targets`, `hook_disclosure`; OP-151 m.10 (e)), the hosted pages' `csp_mode` (`enforce` or `report_only`), `related_origins` (TN-18) and `locale_overrides` by locale and key (X35).

SsoEnforcementPreview.description: What enforcing SSO on the organization would end; nothing changes until idp.org.sso_enforce commits (TN-94, X20, OP-155 m.3 (i)). Each active member with its local sign-in methods, directory app passwords (API keys), open sign-ins and refresh families; the service accounts, members whose API keys enforcement revokes; and the pending invitations, whose fate the enforcement names (cancel or redirect_to_sso).

Declared.description: A resource whose route is declared and not served yet; its lane names its members when it serves it (OP-155 m.4).

Page.description: One page; the next is in the `Link` header (OP-65). Only what the realm may see is listed (TN-113).

WriteResult.description: The Exercise the write compiled to (TN-110), the resource as it now is, and a server-generated `client_secret` (CR-38) or hook or webhook `verification_key` (TN-135, TN-136) shown this once.

client_secret.description: Shown once; never stored or read back.

verification_key.description: The `whpk_` public key or `whsec_` secret a hook's or webhook's receiver verifies with; shown once, never read back.

offer.description: An administrator's binding offer, a compact JWS of type `binding-offer+jwt` signed by this realm's key, for the peer realm's `bindAccount` (OP-153 m.18 (e)); shown once.

bundle.description: A migration export's bundle, dCBOR as unpadded base64url, sealed to the recipient key the change names (TN-86); shown once, never kept.

setup_link.description: An organization's one-use SSO setup link, valid 72 hours; shown once and kept only as its token's SHA-256 (TN-134).

challenge.description: A domain claim's challenge, published as `suiss-access-verify=<challenge>` in a DNS TXT record at `_suiss-access.<domain>` or at `https://<domain>/.well-known/suiss-access-verify`; shown once, kept only as its SHA-256 (TN-90).

irreversible.description: Set on an RP ID change: it cannot be undone and the realm's passkeys stop working (IDI-4).

Tenant.description: A tenant's metadata; never its realms' content (INV-29, X31).

SandboxBudget.description: The sandbox template's fixed budget (OP-151 m.3 (m)); structural fair use, not a plan.

RealmMetadata.description: A realm's metadata and the state of its signing keys; never its settings, accounts, clients or authority state (INV-29, X31, TN-119).

domain.description: Its governing DomainID: the digest of its Genesis record.

sandbox.description: Whether its governing domain is a sandbox (OP-151 m.3 (m)).

key_state.description: Its JOSE keys: none published yet, published and inside the publish lead, signing, or the signer did not answer (CR-25, SAI-46).

signing_available_at.description: When its first key may sign at the latest: creation plus the publish lead, 90 minutes by default (CR-25); the founding-key exception (CR-59) may make it sooner.

OperatorHealth.description: The deployment's readiness checks by name; no addresses, keys or secrets.

TenantPage.description: One page of tenants; the next is in the `Link` header (OP-65).

RealmPage.description: One page of realms or sandbox domains; the next is in the `Link` header (OP-65).

FoundingRoot.description: The founding root of the new governing domain (TN-111): `joint` with `k` of `parties`, recommended, or `sole` with one Party; a Party is its 16-byte id, unpadded base64url.

TenantCreate.description: A new tenant; the draft assigns its `tenant_id`.

tenant_id.description: Assigned by the draft; send it back unchanged.

ais.description: The caller's AIS, when not in the header.

RealmCreate.description: A new realm and the Genesis of its governing domain (TN-111, §5.16). A sole root needs `acknowledge_no_recovery: true` (TN-60, §13.7.7).

causal_binding.description: Declare causal-bound allowances: an upstream ExerciseID backs at most one downstream Exercise, and chained decisions answer `causal_binding: enforced` (§7.9.7.4, E17).

sandbox.description: Open the governing domain from the sandbox template, a separate AuthorityDomain with its fixed budget (OP-151 m.3 (m)); always true on `sandbox-domains`.

ais.description: The caller's AIS, when not in the header.

Genesis.description: What the new governing domain's Genesis declares (TN-111, §13.7.7): its digest (the DomainID), its root's shape, and whether it can be recovered.

recovery.description: `not_available`: the rootTerms `domain.recover` entry cannot be built; the domain cannot be recovered (NG, N-14).

PlatformWriteResult.description: The `idp.platform.*` Exercise the write compiled to (TN-110), what it created, and for a realm its Genesis.

read_scope.description: The scope a read needs at least.

domain.description: The surface's governing DomainID, unpadded base64url.

items.description: A `RateLimit-Policy` item of the caller's own budget.

Request-Id.description: The request's W3C trace id, 32 lower-case hex digits: the `traceparent` trace id when one was sent (OP-65, OP-67).

RateLimit-Policy.description: The quotas that applied (IETF httpapi RateLimit header fields): `"<name>";q=<quota>;w=<window seconds>`, per layer (TN-127).

RateLimit.description: What is left of each quota: `"<name>";r=<remaining>;t=<seconds to reset>`.

ETag.description: The resource version, a strong entity tag; send it in `If-Match` to update (OP-65).

Link.description: RFC 8288 `rel="next"` to the next page; absent on the last page.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745: when the operation was deprecated, `@<unix seconds>`.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594: when the operation goes away, an HTTP-date.

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context; its trace id becomes `Request-Id`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every write: the AIS nonce, unpadded base64url. The same key and request replay the first answer for 24 hours; another request is 422; a running one 409 (TN-126).

Ais.name: X-Access-AIS
Ais.description: The caller's actor intent statement, a `COSE_Sign1` signed with its Instance key, unpadded base64url; or the body member `ais` (TN-110, PI-7).

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The resource's ETag (OP-65): 428 without, 412 on a mismatch.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque; from the `Link` of the previous page.

Filter.name: filter
Filter.description: SCIM filter subset: eq, ne, co, sw, pr, and, or, parentheses; an attribute the endpoint does not name is 400 (TN-112).

BadRequest.description: Malformed request: query, filter, cursor, body or Idempotency-Key.

Unauthorized.description: No usable credential for this surface: invalid-token, wrong-audience, token-lifetime, ais-required or ais-invalid.

NotFound.description: No such resource, or one the caller may not see (TN-113).

NotYetServed.description: not-yet-served: the route is declared and its lane does not serve it yet; nothing was read or changed (OP-154 m.4).

Unavailable.description: A dependency is unavailable; nothing changed.

read_token.description: A DPoP-bound access token (RFC 9449) whose one audience is the surface's and whose scopes include the operation's; at most 60 minutes; with its `DPoP` proof (TN-27, OP-151 m.3 (c)).

ais.name: X-Access-AIS
ais.description: The caller's AIS signed with a live Instance key of the surface's governing domain (PI-7, TN-110).
